claims.claim: The skill covers creating, reviewing, updating, querying, superseding, validating, summarizing, and reporting on ADRs rather than generic documentation.
The workflow follows existing directory and numbering conventions, asks before creating a new location, limits each new record to one decision, and summarizes resulting paths and assumptions.
The writing rules preserve rejected or superseded rationale and require context, an active decision, and positive, negative, and neutral consequences.
The skill documents self-contained helper commands for initialization, creation, linking, listing, reports, validation, slugs, and filenames.
Directory discovery searches upward for `.adr-dir`, then `doc/adr`, and otherwise resolves a default under the repository root.
New ADR creation selects the next record number, refuses duplicate files or numbers, renders a template, writes exclusively, and refreshes neighbor navigation.
The CLI maps explicit commands to handlers, reports invalid commands as failures, and exposes validation with a nonzero result when issues remain.
